archidoc_supplier_payment_assignments_da.name: archidoc_supplier_payment_assignments_dates_chk
archidoc_supplier_payment_assignments_da.value: "archidoc_supplier_payment_assignments"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "archidoc_supplier_payment_assignments"."valid_until" IS NULL OR "archidoc_supplier_payment_assignments"."valid_from" <= "archidoc_supplier_payment_assignments"."valid_until"

archidoc_technical_lots_lifecycle_chk.name: archidoc_technical_lots_lifecycle_chk
archidoc_technical_lots_lifecycle_chk.value: ("archidoc_technical_lots"."is_active" = true AND "archidoc_technical_lots"."deleted_at" IS NULL) OR "archidoc_technical_lots"."is_active" = false

benchmark_documents_contractor_identity_.name: benchmark_documents_contractor_identity_check
benchmark_documents_contractor_identity_.value: ("benchmark_documents"."contractor_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("benchmark_documents"."external_contractor_name" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("benchmark_documents"."external_contractor_name")) > 0)

certificat_architect_invoice_confirmatio.name: certificat_architect_invoice_confirmation
certificat_architect_invoice_confirmatio.value: "certificat_architect_invoices"."frozen_at" IS NULL OR "certificat_architect_invoices"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL OR "certificat_architect_invoices"."confirmed_without_invoice"

certificat_sources_exactly_one_target.name: certificat_sources_exactly_one_target
certificat_sources_exactly_one_target.value: ("certificat_sources"."situation_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("certificat_sources"."invoice_id" IS NOT NULL)

devis_closure_audit_chk.name: devis_closure_audit_chk
devis_closure_audit_chk.value: ("devis"."closure_state" = 'open' AND "devis"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "devis"."closed_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "devis"."closure_marche_id" IS NULL AND "devis"."closure_project_id" IS NULL AND "devis"."closure_contractor_id" IS NULL AND "devis"."closure_reception_date" IS NULL) OR ("devis"."closure_state" = 'closed' AND "devis"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "devis"."closed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "devis"."closure_marche_id" IS NOT NULL AND "devis"."closure_project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "devis"."closure_contractor_id" IS NOT NULL AND "devis"."closure_reception_date" IS NOT NULL)

document_advisories_subject_check.name: document_advisories_subject_check
document_advisories_subject_check.value: ("document_advisories"."devis_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("document_advisories"."invoice_id" IS NOT NULL)

external_works_state_check.name: external_works_state_check
external_works_state_check.value: "external_works"."status" IN ('active', 'void') AND "external_works"."version" > 0 AND ("external_works"."status" <> 'void' OR ("external_works"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("external_works"."void_reason")) > 0))

intake_manual_promotions_target_check.name: intake_manual_promotions_target_check
intake_manual_promotions_target_check.value: ("intake_manual_promotions"."promoted_kind" = 'devis' AND "intake_manual_promotions"."target_devis_id" IS NULL) OR ("intake_manual_promotions"."promoted_kind" = 'invoice' AND "intake_manual_promotions"."target_devis_id" IS NOT NULL)

intake_project_identity_resolutions_labe.name: intake_project_identity_resolutions_label_check
intake_project_identity_resolutions_labe.value: "intake_project_identity_resolutions"."labelled_project_name" IS NOT NULL OR "intake_project_identity_resolutions"."labelled_project_reference" IS NOT NULL

planning_revision_sources_pdf_provenance.name: planning_revision_sources_pdf_provenance_chk
planning_revision_sources_pdf_provenance.value: "planning_revision_sources"."source_kind" != 'pdf_upload' OR ("planning_revision_sources"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL AND "planning_revision_sources"."file_name" IS NOT NULL AND "planning_revision_sources"."file_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "planning_revision_sources"."mime_type" IS NOT NULL AND "planning_revision_sources"."file_size_bytes" IS NOT NULL)

planning_revisions_amounts_ttc_ht_chk.name: planning_revisions_amounts_ttc_ht_chk
planning_revisions_amounts_ttc_ht_chk.value: "planning_revisions"."amount_ttc" IS NULL OR "planning_revisions"."amount_ht" IS NULL OR "planning_revisions"."amount_ttc" >= "planning_revisions"."amount_ht"

planning_revisions_reviewed_audit_chk.name: planning_revisions_reviewed_audit_chk
planning_revisions_reviewed_audit_chk.value: "planning_revisions"."status" != 'reviewed' OR ("planning_revisions"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "planning_revisions"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

planning_revisions_approved_audit_chk.name: planning_revisions_approved_audit_chk
planning_revisions_approved_audit_chk.value: "planning_revisions"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'superseded') OR ("planning_revisions"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "planning_revisions"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "planning_revisions"."approved_snapshot" IS NOT NULL AND "planning_revisions"."approved_snapshot_sha256" IS NOT NULL)

planning_revisions_superseded_audit_chk.name: planning_revisions_superseded_audit_chk
planning_revisions_superseded_audit_chk.value: "planning_revisions"."status" != 'superseded' OR ("planning_revisions"."superseded_by" IS NOT NULL AND "planning_revisions"."superseded_at" IS NOT NULL)
